predecessors.name: French Indochina
predecessors.text: Vietnam south of the 17th parallel: 'the State of Vietnam would rule the territory south of the 17th parallel' (Geneva Accords, 21 July 1954)

successors.name: Democratic Republic of Vietnam
successors.text: the whole of the Republic: 'Communist forces overran Saigon on 30 April 1975'; 'North Vietnam controlled South Vietnam under military occupation'

successors.name: Provisional Revolutionary Government of the Republic of South Vietnam
successors.text: South Vietnam: 'After the Fall of Saigon on 30 April 1975, the PRG assumed power in South Vietnam'

ledger.x: 1955: the Republic of Vietnam is proclaimed at Saigon (26 October) with Ngô Đình Diệm as president.
1961: the Viet Cong hold half the countryside south and southwest of Saigon.
ledger.cpn: Provisional Revolutionary Government of the Republic of South Vietnam

ledger.x: 1967: the Second Republic is established (1 April, infobox); the state, its colour and its land continue under President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu.
July 1970: the attacks end ('April-July 1970') and the South Vietnamese and US forces withdraw; the exact day (22 July) is the Cambodia dossier's, not this page's.
1973: the Paris Peace Accords (27 January) leave the communist forces in their zones.
1974: China seizes the Paracels from South Vietnam.
30 April 1975: the zones merge into the conquest of the whole Republic.
30 April 1975: the war ends with 'Communist forces overran Saigon on 30 April 1975'; the contested land becomes the PRG's and Hanoi's.
ledger.cpn: Provisional Revolutionary Government of the Republic of South Vietnam

ledger.x: 30 April 1975: Saigon falls and the Republic of Vietnam ends.

wars.name: Vietnam War
wars.outcome: The communist side won: Saigon fell on 30 April 1975 and the Republic ended; the PRG and North Vietnam merged into the Socialist Republic of Vietnam on 2 July 1976.

wars.name: Cambodian campaign
wars.outcome: South Vietnamese and US forces struck PAVN/VC bases in eastern Cambodia between April and July 1970 and withdrew.

wars.name: Easter Offensive
wars.outcome: 'North Vietnam launched a conventional invasion of South Vietnam in late March 1972.'

wars.name: Battle of the Paracel Islands
wars.outcome: 'China seized control of the Paracels in 1974 after the South Vietnamese navy attempted an assault on PRC-claimed islands.'
